pairs.subject: error-handling
pairs.evidence: src/app/report/[owner]/[repo]/page.tsx:59 Failed server-side data reads are explicitly caught, routed to telemetry and operator logs, and distinguished from empty results so failures are never silently swallowed or misrepresented to users.

techniques.evidence: src/components/report/useReportScan.ts:439 Attributed reason is set at the site of cancellation (timeout vs user abort) so the catch handler classifies by cause rather than guessing from the causeless AbortError.
src/components/report/ReportClient.tsx:15 Internal UI application terminating in render doors rather than an independently shipped and versioned library boundary.
src/app/report/[owner]/[repo]/page.tsx:84 Context is a read-only reporting shell with no long-lived mutating document or session state requiring snapshot rollback.
src/app/report/[owner]/[repo]/opengraph-image.tsx:36 Failed data reads route to operator logging and telemetry doors via reportDegradedRead rather than failing silently.
src/app/report/page.tsx:13 Web UI shell in Next.js with no process supervisor exit status or CLI contract.
src/components/report/useReportScan.ts:393 Reports are parsed as single cohesive documents where payload corruption fails the report rather than an externally owned collection of items.
src/components/report/useReportScan.ts:312 Error classification across HTTP and SSE boundaries checks machine status codes and structured fields rather than parsing localized error prose.
src/app/report/[owner]/[repo]/page.tsx:280 Degraded best-effort reads are routed through degradeTo door helpers to prevent silent swallows, reinforced by AST guard tests.
src/components/report/useReportScan.ts:39 Defines a closed failure taxonomy (ScanErrorClass) separating transient issues from permanent fault lines and extracting remediation data (resetAt).
src/components/report/ReportClient.tsx:73 Maps classified failure states to specific product surfaces pairing honest failure descriptions with actionable remedies like credit top-up.
